description: Returns the profile card of a Jam Jam account designated by its public @handle, seen from the calling account: display name, bio, avatar, visibility (public/private), follower and following counts, and `relation` (none / following / follower / mutual / requested / self). A PRIVATE account the caller does not follow returns a closed card without bio or counts. An unknown handle returns not-found. Jam Jam is a host: this never ranks or recommends anyone, and never exposes somebody else's audience figures.

handle.description: Public username of the account, with or without the leading "@".

name: jj_get_profile
title: Get a public profile card
